notes.title: PWAP Update 1.5
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Lots of optimization around the game.
[*] Fixed crash in settings on Steam Deck.
[*] Fixed bug where player could not throw grenades after the tutorial.
[*] Controller schemes are now available in-game for Switch Pro, XBox and PS controllers.
[*] XBox will be default controller scheme.
[/list]

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.notes:
Feedback I have been given have been that the Left ThumbStick couldn't be used for moving.
That has been fixed now.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Changed PCG algo to support set pieces.

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Monsters now can't move through doors in the hallway.
[*] Framerate should stay at max even when the game is unfocused. This should help some streamers out there.
[/list]

Have fun.

notes.title: Demo update
notes.notes:
The demo has been updated with some important fixes made to the main game.

Physics have been updated to support frame independent game time.
All characters have been updated to support frame independent game time.
Lighting effects from alpha has been added.
Better/more fun particles.
